salesforce-h360.description: Salesforce Headless 360 MCP server. Five tools: discover(query) *should be blocked* - semantic search across Salesforce APIs to find available operations; describe(id) *should be blocked* - full specification for a discovered operation or object; dispatch(method, url, queryParams, body) *should be blocked* and dispatch_readonly(method, url, queryParams, body) - execute any Salesforce REST API call (SOQL queries, sObject CRUD, UI API, Tooling API), which supports read and guided create/update on Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Leads, and activities; display_widget(json) - validates and renders widget json.
